strategy: Extend the Starter manifest with exact Skill implementation members and integrity-bind every package file. Add a provenance-only runtime registration record that points back to the verified package instead of copying semantic rows into global registries. Resolve one exact entrypoint into the canonical WorkflowSpec, activate that spec through the existing Capability Resolver, show effects before execution, and provide an injected generic start/resume bootstrap that delegates to WorkflowAdapterDispatcher, LangGraph, a durable checkpointer, and the existing TaskRun bridge.

changes.reason: real Host execution requires an integrity-bound implementation, not only a contract

changes.reason: Skill source binding must remain open and reviewable

unchanged_boundaries: WorkflowSpec and workflow_graph_contract remain sole Workflow semantic/topology authorities
Capability Registry and Resolver remain sole Provider binding authorities
WorkflowAdapterDispatcher remains sole step dispatch owner
a real Host must execute SKILL.md before the existing receipt can be emitted
mutating adapters still require the existing injected Write Authority Guard
LangGraph owns routing only and TaskRun remains lifecycle/completion authority
Graph END projects only to TaskRun VALIDATING
Starter registration and route construction execute no provider and grant no authority
customer application source and runtime remain independent of Harness
forbidden_repairs: Do not append Starter Workflows or Skills into static global registries.
Do not treat a registration record as a semantic cache or authority grant.
Do not fabricate a Skill receipt from graph position or a Skill contract.
Do not fuzzy-map free-form language to a mutating Workflow.
Do not accept an in-memory LangGraph checkpointer for executable runtime.
Do not start a second TaskRun or mark TaskRun COMPLETED from Graph END.
Do not add merge capability to Customer Agent Workflows.
Do not execute arbitrary Project command strings during registration or routing.
required_invariants: every Skill contract identity has exactly one digest-bound SKILL.md package member
registration points to a bounded project-local package and fails on package drift
entrypoint and slash-command resolution are exact and closed
write effects and remote effects are shown before runtime execution
write-governed execution cannot proceed without the existing guard in the injected Dispatcher
runtime start requires an existing matching TaskRun and durable checkpointer
resume accepts only the exact WAITING_EXTERNAL or HUMAN_GATE state and TaskRun phase
the canonical bridge projects Graph END to VALIDATING only

focused: all seven bundled SKILL.md files validate and match Skill contract identities
registration and load reproduce the exact package digest and entrypoint WorkflowSpec
read-only and write entrypoints produce correct effect previews and activation bindings
generic runtime starts and resumes through injected Dispatcher/checkpointer/TaskRun bridge
counterexamples: Skill source drift, missing files, wrong frontmatter name, and traversal are rejected
registration/package digest drift and entrypoint mismatch are rejected
unknown or ambiguous slash commands fail without Workflow selection
write runtime without Write Guard and runtime with memory checkpointer fail closed
resume with wrong event, workflow, TaskRun phase, or correlation fails closed
regression: Starter, Authoring, Composition, Invocation, Activation, Dispatcher, LangGraph, and TaskRun tests remain green
negative_path: registration and routing have no execution or authority effect
no static registry rows are added
no Customer Agent Workflow gains merge capability

risks: A registration file could become stale; every load re-verifies the package digest and exact paths.
Host implementations could claim execution without loading the bound file; receipt validation binds the expected source digest and path.
Project commands are not yet safe runtime profiles; this stage deliberately does not execute arbitrary command strings.
Concrete workspace/git/PR adapters are not all implemented; missing injected adapters remain runtime blockers rather than simulated success.
rollback_plan: Remove Starter runtime registration/routing/bootstrap, injected Skill path support, bundled SKILL.md files, related schemas/tests/docs, and restore Starter manifest v1 shape. Existing static registries, Workflow runtime, Provider adapters, TaskRun, and customer source require no rollback.
